cost.source: NASA CLPS / HLS award values 2019-2023, nominal USD (Wikipedia pages of CLPS, Nova-C, Peregrine, Blue Ghost, Griffin, Blue Moon, read 9 Nov 2026); docs/domain/scenario-archetypes.md; not the provider's own cost

launch.source: Wikipedia Falcon 9 Block 5, Falcon Heavy and New Glenn pages (tank capacities, 12 Nov 2026); stoichiometry C + O2 -> CO2 (44.01/12.011) and CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O (44.01/16.04)

production.source: primary aluminium 8.24-15.1 kg CO2e/kg (ICE v3 via a calculator page; global average 15.1; web search, 12 Nov 2026); not read from the ICE tables

limits: Class scenario from public award values and vehicle data: not a quote, not an LCA, not a forecast of this mission.
